#### Map showing regions:

```{r}

#doesn't have channel isl geometry (a part of sb county)
CA_shp <- st_read(here("./data/rawdata/shp/CA/cb_2025_06_cousub_500k/cb_2025_06_cousub_500k.shp")) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 4326) %>% #setting to wgs84 
  mutate(
    degx = st_coordinates(st_centroid(geometry))[, 1],
    degy = st_coordinates(st_centroid(geometry))[, 2],
    region = case_when(degy >= 37.29 ~ "norca",
                       degy < 37.29 & degy >= 34.8 ~ "centralca",
                       degy < 34.8 ~ "socal",
                       degy <= 34.14096 & degy >= 33.84145 & 
                         degx >= -120.54587 & degx <= -119.32878 ~ "channel"),
    region = factor(region, levels = c("socal","channel","centralca","norca"))
  )

#want to make a separate polygon for channel islands so I can color it differently
channel_bbox1 = st_bbox(c(xmin=-120.54587, ymin=33.84145, xmax=-119.32878, ymax=34.14096), crs = st_crs(CA_shp))
channel_bbox2 = st_bbox(c(xmin=-119.78977, ymin=32.70343, xmax=-118.20716, ymax=33.64047), crs = st_crs(CA_shp))

boxes_combined <- st_union(st_as_sfc(channel_bbox1), st_as_sfc(channel_bbox2))

channel_clip <- st_intersection(CA_shp,boxes_combined)

#data from here: https://data.ca.gov/dataset/california-marine-protected-areas-ds582
mpa_shp <- st_read(here("./data/rawdata/shp/mpa/California_Marine_Protected_Areas_[ds582]/California_Marine_Protected_Areas_[ds582].shp")) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 4326) #setting to wgs84
  
mpa_shp_filtered <- mpa_shp %>% 
  filter(NAME %in% mpa_centroids$NAME) %>% #filter for chosen MPAs
  left_join(mpa_centroids %>% select("NAME","region"),
            by = "NAME")


region_cols <- c(
  "norca" = "#8da0cb",
  "centralca" = "#fc8d62",
  "channel" = "#66c2a5",
  "socal" = "#e78ac3"
)


make_map <- function(bbox, title, legend) {
    #CA baselayer
    tm_shape(CA_shp, bbox = bbox) +
    tm_polygons(fill = "region",
                fill.scale = tm_scale_categorical(values = region_cols),
                fill_alpha = 0.5,
                fill.legend = tm_legend(show = FALSE),
              lwd = 0) +
   #channel islands layer to color correctly
    tm_shape(channel_clip, bbox = bbox) +
    tm_polygons(fill = "#66c2a5",
                fill_alpha = 0.5,
                lwd = 0) +
   #mpas
    tm_shape(mpa_shp_filtered) +
    tm_polygons(fill = "region",
                fill.scale = tm_scale_categorical(values = region_cols),
                lwd = 0,
                fill.legend = tm_legend(show = legend)) +
    tm_graticules(alpha = 0.1) +
    tm_layout(frame = FALSE,
              inner.margins = c(0.03, 0.03, 0.03, 0.03),
              component.autoscale = FALSE) +
    tm_title(title)
}

norcal <- make_map(c(-125, 37, -122, 42), "Northern CA", FALSE)
centralca <- make_map(c(-123, 34.5, -120, 37.5), "Central CA",FALSE)
socal <- make_map(c(-121, 32.5, -117, 34.5), "Southern CA & Ch. Isl",TRUE)

tmap_arrange(socal,centralca,norcal,nrow = 1)
```

## PCA

PCA of all summary stats (mean, lower 10th percentile, upper 10th percentile, seasonal SD, event SD) clustered by regions within specified time period.

```{r}
make_pca <- function(mod_sumstat){
  
  model_name <- sub("sumstat.*", "", deparse(substitute(mod_sumstat)))
  
  sumstat_4pca <- mod_sumstat %>%
    select(-OBJECTID, -NAME, -File, -SHORTNAME,
         -degx, -degy, -region, -period)

  # PCA on all observations
  pca <- prcomp(sumstat_4pca, scale. = TRUE)

  #varimax rotation
  n_comp <- 2
  raw_loadings <- pca$rotation[, 1:n_comp]
  varimax_res  <- varimax(raw_loadings)
  
  pca$rotation[, 1:n_comp] <- varimax_res$loadings
  
  scaled_data <- scale(sumstat_4pca)
  pca$x[, 1:n_comp] <- scaled_data %*% varimax_res$loadings
  
  pca$rotation[,1:2] <- -pca$rotation[,1:2]
  pca$x[,1:2] <- -pca$x[,1:2]
  
  #Keep first 3 PCs and add metada
  scores <- as.data.frame(pca$x[,1:3])
  scores$MPA <- mod_sumstat$NAME
  scores$MPA_num <- mod_sumstat$OBJECTID
  scores$region <- mod_sumstat$region
  scores$period <- factor(mod_sumstat$period, levels = c("presentday","midcen","endcen"))
  
  
  # A. Base plot: eigenvectors only
  pca_eigenvectors <- fviz_pca_biplot(
    pca, axes = c(1,2), repel = TRUE, col.var = "black",
    addEllipses = FALSE, invisible = "ind"
  ) +
    labs(title = paste0(model_name, " PCA Eigenvectors"))

  
  # B. Eigenvectors + present-day points
  plot_presentday <- pca_eigenvectors +
    geom_point(
      data = scores %>% filter(period == "presentday"),
      aes(PC1, PC2, color = region),
      size = 2, alpha = 0.7,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = region_cols,
      breaks = c("socal", "channel", "centralca","norca")
    ) +
    labs(title = paste0(model_name, " PCA - Present Day"))
  
  # C. Eigenvectors + present-day and end-century points
  plot_endcen <- pca_eigenvectors +
    geom_point(
      data = scores %>% 
        filter(period %in% c("presentday", "endcen")),
      aes(PC1, PC2, color = region, shape = period),
      size = 2, alpha = 0.7,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = region_cols,
      breaks = c("norca", "centralca", "socal", "channel")
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c(presentday = 16, endcen = 15)
    ) +
    labs(title = paste0(model_name, " PCA - Present Day and End Century"))
  

  return(list(pca = pca, scores = scores, eigenvectors = pca_eigenvectors, 
              presentday = plot_presentday, endcen = plot_endcen))

}
```

### Find diff in PC over time

```{r}

ensemble_scores <- ensemble_pca$scores
scores_wide <- ensemble_scores %>%
  select("PC1","PC2") %>%
#I think the rows correspond to each individual mpa for a certain time period, corresponds to sumstat file, need to merge this and only select pc1 since its most explanatory 
  cbind(ensemble_sumstat) %>%
#convert from long to wide (for period) 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c("File","region","SHORTNAME"),
              names_from = "period",
              values_from = c("PC1","PC2")) 


#mpa PC changes:
mpa_change <- scores_wide %>%
  
  mutate("PC1" = PC1_endcen - PC1_presentday,
         "PC2" = PC2_endcen - PC2_presentday) %>%
  
  pivot_longer(cols = c("PC1","PC2"), 
               names_to = "PC", 
               values_to = "PC_diff") %>%
  
  select(-PC1_endcen,-PC1_presentday,-PC1_midcen,-PC2_endcen,-PC2_presentday,-PC2_midcen) %>%
  
  mutate(region = factor(region, 
                         levels = c("socal", "channel", "centralca",
                                    "norca"))) 


#averaged across regions: -------------------------
region_mpa_change_summary <- mpa_change %>%
  group_by(PC, region) %>%
  summarise(mean_pc_change = mean(PC_diff, na.rm=TRUE),
            sd_pc_change = sd(PC_diff)) %>%

arrange(PC, region)


#contrasts -------------------------------------
pc_change_mod <- lm(PC_diff ~ PC*region, data = mpa_change)
summary(pc_change_mod)
anova(pc_change_mod)

EMM <- emmeans(pc_change_mod, ~ PC*region)


pc_contrast <- contrast(EMM, method = "pairwise", by = "region") %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(p.value = ifelse(p.value < 0.01, "< 0.01", p.value),
         across(c(estimate, SE, df, t.ratio),~ round(.x, 3)))

flextable(pc_contrast) %>% 
  set_caption("PC1 vs. PC2 contrasts within each region") %>%
  autofit()



region_contrast <- contrast(EMM, method = "pairwise", by = "PC") %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
   mutate(p.value = ifelse(p.value < 0.01, "< 0.01", 
                           round(p.value,3)),
         across(c(estimate, SE, df, t.ratio),~ round(.x, 3)))

flextable(region_contrast) %>% 
  bold(i = ~ p.value < 0.01,
        j = "p.value",
    bold = TRUE) %>% 
  set_caption("Regional contrasts within each PC") %>%
  
  autofit()



#based on the region contrast table
sig_letters <- data.frame(
  region = c("socal", "channel", "centralca", "norca"),

) %>%

plot_data <- region_mpa_change_summary %>%

#graph of mean change in pc per region ---------------------------------
ggplot(region_mpa_change_summary,
```

### Residual analysis

```{r}
#running lm model of presentday vs. endcen
PC1_mod <- lm(PC1_endcen ~ PC1_presentday, data = scores_wide)
PC2_mod <- lm(PC2_endcen ~ PC2_presentday, data = scores_wide)


scores_long <- scores_wide %>%
  select(region, PC1_presentday, PC1_endcen, PC1_fitted,
         PC2_presentday, PC2_endcen, PC2_fitted) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -region,
    names_to = c("PC", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(PC[12])_(presentday|endcen|fitted)"
  )

ggplot(scores_long, aes(x = presentday, y = endcen)) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(xend = presentday, yend = fitted),
    color = "gray60",
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(color = region), size = 2.5) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~PC,
    scales = "free",
    labeller = as_labeller(c(
      PC1 = "PC1",
      PC2 = "PC2"
    ))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Present-day vs. End-century PCA scores",
    x = "Present-day PC score",
    y = "End-century PC score",
    color = "Region"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

#saving residuals
pc_residuals <- scores_wide %>% 
  
  mutate(PC1_residual = residuals(PC1_mod),
         PC2_residual = residuals(PC2_mod)) %>%
 
  select(-c(4:9)) %>%
  
  #for plotting both periods on same graph
  pivot_longer(cols = c(-File,-region,-SHORTNAME),
               names_to = "descriptor",
               values_to = "residual") %>%
  
  #adding id columns
  mutate(PC = substr(descriptor,1,3), .after = descriptor) %>%
  
  select(-descriptor) %>%

  #finding regional means and sd
  group_by(region, PC) %>%
  
  mutate(region_mean = mean(residual, na.rm = TRUE),
         region_sd = sd(residual, na.rm = TRUE),
         dist_from_mean = abs(residual - region_mean),
         label = ifelse(dist_from_mean >= quantile(dist_from_mean, 0.9, na.rm = TRUE),
                                                   SHORTNAME, NA),
         region = factor(region, 
                         levels = c("socal", "channel", "centralca",
                                    "norca"))
         ) 

#regional comparisons for contrasts (letters on bars)
PC1_region_mod <- lm(residual ~ region,
                     data = filter(pc_residuals, PC == "PC1"))

PC1_contrasts <- pairs(emmeans(PC1_region_mod, ~ region),
                       adjust = "tukey") %>% as.data.frame()
      
PC2_region_mod <- lm(residual ~ region,
                     data = filter(pc_residuals, PC == "PC2"))

PC2_contrasts <- pairs(emmeans(PC2_region_mod, ~ region),
                       adjust = "tukey")

#all are signif!!

#plot
p <- ggplot(pc_residuals, aes(x = region, y = residual, color = region)) +

  # Individual MPA residuals
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.12,
    alpha = 0.5,
    size = 2
  ) +
  
  # Label outlier MPAs
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = label),
    na.rm = TRUE,
    size = 3,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  # Regional mean and SD
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    fun.min = function(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE) - sd(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    fun.max = function(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE) + sd(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0.2,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    size = 4
    
  ) +

  # Zero reference line
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "gray50"
  ) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = region_cols) +

  facet_wrap(~ PC, ncol = 2) +

  labs(
    x = "Region",
    y = "Residual from present-day to end-century relationship",
    caption = "Large points represent regional mean residuals; error bars represent ±1 SD; small points represent individual MPAs."
  ) +
  
  scale_x_discrete(
  labels = c(
    "socal" = "Southern CA",
    "channel" = "Channel Islands",
    "centralca" = "Central CA",
    "norca" = "Northern CA"
  )) +

  theme_classic()

```

## Anomalous pH/DO/temp Event Analysis

Identify pH/DO/temp anomalous events. Events for pH are defined as 2+ days where pH \< 7.75, and events for DO are 2+ days where DO \< 4.6. Events for temp defined as 2+ days where daily temp exceeds presentdayal climatology's temp for that month + 2\* presentdayal climatology SD.

Main summary statistic: difference in average number of days in a year an MPA experiences an event across time periods

Function for labeling events:

```{r}
# Create labels for events (e.g., consecutive days with low pH or low DO) using run length encoding

label_events <- function(is_event) {
  event_rle <- rle(is_event)
  labels <- ifelse(event_rle$values, cumsum(event_rle$values), NA)
  rep(labels, event_rle$lengths)
}
```

pH and DO events:

```{r}
ph_do_events <- mpa %>%
  group_by(period) %>%
  select(File, Date, Year,NAME, pH, DO, period, degx, degy, julianday) %>%
  mutate(is_pH_low = pH < 7.75,
         pH_event_id = ifelse(is_pH_low == "FALSE", NA, label_events(is_pH_low)),
         is_DO_low = DO < 4.6,
         DO_event_id = ifelse(is_DO_low == "FALSE", NA, label_events(is_DO_low))) 

#pH event summary
ph_do_event_summary <- ph_do_events %>%

  #ph events (only calculate summary stats when an event took place)
  #note: events with 1 day are changed to NA (bc event defined as 2+ days)
  group_by(File, pH_event_id, period) %>% 
  mutate(pH_duration_days = if_else(is_pH_low == "TRUE", n(), NA),
         pH_duration_days = if_else(pH_duration_days == 1, NA, pH_duration_days), 
         pH_event_id = if_else(pH_duration_days == 0, NA, pH_event_id),
         pH_event_mean = if_else(pH_duration_days > 1, mean(pH, na.rm = TRUE), NA)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  
  #do events
  group_by(File, DO_event_id, period) %>% 
  mutate(DO_duration_days = if_else(is_DO_low == "TRUE", n(), NA),
         DO_duration_days = if_else(DO_duration_days == 1, NA, DO_duration_days), 
         DO_event_id = if_else(DO_duration_days == 0, NA, DO_event_id),
         DO_event_mean = if_else(DO_duration_days > 1, mean(DO, na.rm = TRUE), NA)) %>%
  ungroup() 

#since an event can span multiple years, annual sum is n() in that year (not duration days since that can show duration spanning multiple years)
ph_do_annual_event_counts <- ph_do_event_summary %>%
  #per mpa per year
  group_by(File, Year, period) %>%
  mutate(annual_days_below_pH_thresh = sum(!is.na(pH_event_id)),
         annual_days_below_DO_thresh = sum(!is.na(DO_event_id))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  #per mpa
  group_by(File, period) %>%
  mutate(avg_annual_days_below_pH_thresh = mean(annual_days_below_pH_thresh, na.rm=TRUE),
         avg_annual_days_below_DO_thresh = mean(annual_days_below_DO_thresh, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct(File, NAME, degx, degy, period, avg_annual_days_below_pH_thresh, 
           avg_annual_days_below_DO_thresh)
```

Temperature events:

```{r}
temp_events <- mpa %>%
  
  #first calculating reference presentday climatology
  filter(period == "presentday") %>%
  group_by(File, Month) %>%
  summarise(presentdayclim_Temp_mean = mean(Temp), 
            presentdayclim_Temp_sd = sd(Temp)) %>% #this sd is temp over all days in Jan - rather than average of each jan's SD - does it make a difference? 
 
   #bringing back to scale of julian days and all time periods
  merge(mpa, by = c("File", "Month")) %>%
  select(File, Date, Year, NAME, Temp, period, degx, degy, julianday, presentdayclim_Temp_mean, presentdayclim_Temp_sd) %>%
  
  #labelling events
  group_by(period) %>%
  mutate(is_temp_high = Temp > (presentdayclim_Temp_mean + 2*presentdayclim_Temp_sd),
         temp_event_id = ifelse(is_temp_high == "FALSE", NA, label_events(is_temp_high))) %>%
  select(-presentdayclim_Temp_mean, -presentdayclim_Temp_sd) %>%
         
  #temp event summary 
  group_by(File, temp_event_id, period) %>% 
  mutate(temp_duration_days = if_else(is_temp_high == "TRUE", n(), NA),
         temp_duration_days = if_else(temp_duration_days == 1, NA, temp_duration_days), 
         temp_event_id = if_else(temp_duration_days == 0, NA, temp_event_id),
         temp_event_mean = if_else(temp_duration_days > 1, mean(Temp, na.rm = TRUE), NA)) %>%
  ungroup() 
```

Combining all events:

```{r}
#putting it all together
annual_events <- temp_events %>%
  #first finding annual averages for temp
  #per mpa per year
  group_by(File, Year, period) %>%
  mutate(annual_days_above_temp_thresh = sum(!is.na(temp_event_id))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  
  #per mpa
  group_by(File, period) %>%
  summarise(avg_annual_days_above_temp_thresh = mean(annual_days_above_temp_thresh, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  right_join(ph_do_annual_event_counts, by = c("File", "period"))
```

Plotting maps:

Setting scale and legend breaks

```{r}
CA_shp <- st_read(here("./data/rawdata/shp/CA_Counties/CA_Counties_TIGER2016.shp"))
  
 
#converting df to spatial data format
anom_points <- annual_events %>% 
  st_as_sf(coords = c("degx","degy"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(st_crs(CA_shp))
                          
#creating period diff df: calculating diff btwn time points for diff sumstat
period_diff <- annual_events %>% 
  
  pivot_wider(names_from = period,
              values_from = c(avg_annual_days_above_temp_thresh,
                              avg_annual_days_below_pH_thresh,
                              avg_annual_days_below_DO_thresh),
              names_glue = "{period}_{.value}") %>%
  
  mutate(midpresentday_temp_days = midcen_avg_annual_days_above_temp_thresh -
                             presentday_avg_annual_days_above_temp_thresh,
         endmid_temp_days =  endcen_avg_annual_days_above_temp_thresh -
                             midcen_avg_annual_days_above_temp_thresh,
         
         midpresentday_pH_days = midcen_avg_annual_days_below_pH_thresh -
                           presentday_avg_annual_days_below_pH_thresh,
         endmid_pH_days =  endcen_avg_annual_days_below_pH_thresh -
                           midcen_avg_annual_days_below_pH_thresh,
        
         midpresentday_DO_days = midcen_avg_annual_days_below_DO_thresh -
                           presentday_avg_annual_days_below_DO_thresh,
         endmid_DO_days =  endcen_avg_annual_days_below_DO_thresh -
                           midcen_avg_annual_days_below_DO_thresh) %>%
  
  mutate(across((14:19), as.integer))
                           
                          
#converting period diff df to spatial data format
period_diff_anom_points <- st_as_sf(period_diff, coords = c("degx","degy"), crs = 4326) %>%
                           st_transform(st_crs(CA_shp))
  
#finding equal interval breaks
#instead of all_diff_breaks
temp_diffs <- c(period_diff$midpresentday_temp_days, period_diff$endmid_temp_days)
temp_breaks <- classInt::classIntervals(temp_diffs, 10, "equal")
pH_diffs <- c(period_diff$midpresentday_pH_days, period_diff$endmid_pH_days)
pH_breaks <- classInt::classIntervals(pH_diffs, 10, "equal")
DO_diffs <- c(period_diff$midpresentday_DO_days, period_diff$endmid_DO_days)
DO_breaks <- classInt::classIntervals(DO_diffs, 10, "equal")
```
